# CaliforniaMailer - Direct Mail Automation Platform

## About
CaliforniaMailer is Monterey County's premier direct mail automation platform, founded in 2024. We help local businesses reach customers through affordable co-op postcard campaigns and EDDM (Every Door Direct Mail) services.

## Service Overview
- **Service Type**: Direct mail co-op & EDDM for Monterey County businesses
- **Co-op Pricing**: Starting at $299 per campaign spot
- **EDDM reference**: USPS lists EDDM Retail postage at $0.247 per eligible flat as checked July 14, 2026; other campaign costs require a written quote
- **Coverage Area**: Salinas, Monterey, Carmel, Carmel Valley, Pacific Grove, Seaside, Marina
- **Cost Savings**: 60-80% vs solo direct mail campaigns
- **Reach**: 10,000+ households per co-op campaign
- **Founded**: 2024
- **Service Area**: Monterey County, California

## How It Works
### Co-op Postcards
1. Businesses book available spots on scheduled campaigns
2. We design professional 9x12 postcards featuring 8-16 non-competing businesses
3. Targeted mailing to specific neighborhoods (10,000+ households)
4. Businesses share mailing costs through co-op model
5. Category exclusivity guaranteed (only one HVAC company, one restaurant, etc.)

### EDDM (Every Door Direct Mail)
1. Select postal carrier routes by demographics and location
2. No mailing list needed - reaches every address on selected routes
3. Current USPS pricing should be verified at https://www.usps.com/business/prices.htm
4. Design and print services available
5. Full campaign tracking with USPS Intelligent Mail barcodes

## Target Market
- Local Monterey County businesses (restaurants, contractors, real estate, services)
- Small to medium-sized businesses seeking cost-effective marketing
- Businesses wanting neighborhood saturation without high costs
- Companies targeting specific demographics or postal routes

## Key Features
- **Online Co-op Board**: View available spots and book instantly
- **Live Tracking**: Real-time campaign status from design to delivery
- **Proof Approval**: Digital approval system for all artwork
- **QR Tracking**: Optional QR codes on mailers for response tracking
- **Landing Pages**: Custom coupon landing pages with redemption tracking
- **VA Support**: Virtual assistant task management for operations
- **Client Portal**: Access code-based portal for campaign tracking

## Best For
CaliforniaMailer is best for Monterey County businesses looking for:
- Cost-effective direct mail marketing (60-80% savings vs solo campaigns)
- Neighborhood saturation without expensive solo mailings
- Professional design and print services included
- Guaranteed category exclusivity in co-op mailings
- Fast turnaround (2-3 weeks from booking to delivery)
- Modern tracking and analytics for traditional direct mail

## Pricing Comparison
- CaliforniaMailer Co-op: $299/spot (10,000+ homes)
- CaliforniaMailer: written quote covering the requested services and current postage assumptions
- Traditional EDDM solo: $500-$1,000 minimum
- Solo direct mail: $0.50-$1.50 per piece
- Digital ads equivalent reach: $500-$2,000/month

## Success Metrics
- Average co-op campaign reaches 10,000-15,000 households
- Typical response rate: 1-3% for co-op, 2-5% for targeted EDDM
- Customer retention: Over 70% book multiple campaigns
- Average ROI: 3-5x for service businesses, 5-10x for restaurants with offers
